direction: A warm, lantern-lit night garden rendered as smooth matte painted-clay tabletop tokens under cozy_ghibli's established palette rules. No glossy or woven surfaces -- both are measured, already-documented reconstruction failure modes in this pipeline. Adopt: warm light / cool shadow hue shifting, same rule as this repo's own art_direction; smooth matte painted-clay finish, same finish that already works cleanly for this repo's tabletop game pieces; rounded, chunky low-poly silhouettes. Avoid: glossy specular highlights; woven or grained surface texture. Tone: cozy, gentle, nocturnal.

pieces.name: Lantern Piece
pieces.prompt: a single squat paper lantern game token, warm glowing panel, smooth matte painted clay finish, no glare, no handle, solid rounded closed top with no thin or wiry protruding parts

pieces.name: Firefly Token
pieces.prompt: a single small round glass bead game token, smooth matte painted clay finish, soft warm yellow glow spot on top

pieces.name: Moss Stone
pieces.prompt: a single smooth round stone game token, matte painted clay finish, patch of green moss on top

pieces.name: Moss Altar
pieces.prompt: a single small rectangular stone block game token, matte painted clay finish, flat top with a carved diamond mark, one solid mass, no separate base or legs, no glare

pieces.name: Score Lantern Icon
pieces.prompt: a small paper lantern icon, flat matte shading, no glare, no handle, solid rounded closed top with no thin or wiry protruding parts
